name: Taqueria Pollo Asado Platter (Grilled Chicken, White Rice & Corn Tortillas)
whyItWorks: Citrus-marinated chicken breast or boneless thigh grilled over charcoal until juicy. Paired with plain Mexican white rice (arroz blanco) and soft warm corn tortillas, avoiding refried beans and heavy cheeses.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Pollo Asado platter with plain white rice and corn tortillas—NO refried beans, NO pico de gallo, NO sour cream.' Enjoy with a side of smooth avocado.
